findings.visibleEvidence: After activating campaign 2 and waiting 700ms, active index changes but background, Logo-30th.png, 2M6P_EN_23.png, CTA copy and visible composition remain identical.
findings.recommendedFix: Freeze a second evidenced official campaign state, or have the Design Director explicitly approve a visually distinct held-out fictional campaign. Bind each slide to distinct background, campaign mark/title, featured subject/card and CTA; never claim held-out content is official.

findings.visibleEvidence: Source mobile capture shows an approximately 56px black cap with brand logo left and MENU plus a separate three-line hamburger right. Current runtime nav is approximately 38px high and uses a text glyph hamburger, producing a cramped toolbar-like result.
findings.recommendedFix: Freeze and implement a dedicated 56px mobile header recipe with source-proportioned logo, MENU, CSS/SVG three-line hamburger and a 44px control hit target; hide desktop links from layout and hit testing.

findings.visibleEvidence: Each slide control measures approximately 24x6px with approximately 8px gap.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep the short visual rail but expand each actual button to at least 44x44px using padding or a transparent pseudo-element without overlapping CTA/card targets.

findings.visibleEvidence: Source evidence proves arrow pressed treatment but not a second settled campaign. Current demo shows no asset, text, opacity or transform change after activation and settlement.
findings.recommendedFix: Capture and compare default, triggered, mid-transition, settled and restored states. Use a short nonblank cross-fade/directional transition; reduced-motion must switch immediately.

findings.visibleEvidence: The compact black Hero ends directly against the white News section, while the source uses a clearer black carousel label/control rail as visual closure.
findings.recommendedFix: Use a compact black footer/control rail or a more deliberate transition while preserving the approximately half-screen Hero limit.

findings.visibleEvidence: A future second campaign may need held-out content because current source evidence does not establish a second official settled visual state.
findings.recommendedFix: Expose official-source versus held-out-fictional provenance in inspector and QA artifacts; do not visually or textually label held-out work as official.

releaseConditions: Two visually distinct campaign states with explicit provenance
Mobile navigation matches the source 56px black cap structure
Carousel controls have at least 44x44px effective hit targets
Fresh independent Blind QA confirms no regression in card flip, half-screen boundary or next-section visibility
